ns2:course.label: Numerical Thermo-Fluid Mechs
ns2:course.description: Numerical techniques for solving the equations governing conduction and convective heat transfer in steady and unsteady fluid flows: finite-difference and finite-volume techniques, basic algorithms, and applications to real-world fluid-flow and heat-transfer problems. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 310 and ME 320.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 310 and ME 320.
